definitions.explanation: A sweet, fuzzy fruit with a large pit, or the tree that produces it. Peaches have special significance in Japanese and Chinese culture.

notes:
{桃|もも} refers to peaches (both the fruit and tree).

Common expressions:
- {桃|もも}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧ (peach blossom)
- {桃|もも}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{節句|せっく}→節句：26925_sekku⟧/⟦{雛祭|ひなまつ}り→ひな祭り：10517_hinamatsuri⟧ (Girls' Day, March 3rd - "Peach Festival")
- ⟦{桃|もも}{色|いろ}→桃色：13138_momoiro⟧ (pink; peach color)
- ⟦{白桃|はくとう}→白桃：28492_hakutou⟧ (white peach - premium variety)

Cultural note:
Peaches symbolize longevity and protection against evil in East Asian culture. ⟦{桃太郎|ももたろう}→桃太郎：noentry⟧ (Momotaro) is one of Japan's most famous folk tales. {桃|もも}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{節句|せっく}→節句：26925_sekku⟧ (Hinamatsuri/Girls' Day) on March 3rd features peach blossoms. Japanese white peaches (⟦{白桃|はくとう}→白桃：28492_hakutou⟧), especially from Okayama and Yamanashi, are prized as summer gifts.
